clips.title: The story
paras: In Teldrassil, a lost journal waits to be carried to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar. Its pages record an unknown traveler's simple journeys and camping outings.
You find a journal among Teldrassil's boughs and roots. Its nameless writer records modest wanderings and the simple pleasure of making camp beneath the twilight canopy.
The journal can be carried toward Dolanaar instead of left in the wilderness. Lyreena Duskblade waits near the night elf settlement to receive the lost pages.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.
There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... Fun.

clips.title: Progress

clips.title: Completion
paras: Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, hunter.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
